text: Done in ebb07e5: bundle.compose takes tool_kind and writes it into CAPABILITIES.json, and the Designer passes the intake's tool.kind (the same value that decides whether the common set is carried). It is builder code, so it holds for every build from now on without a template version. meta_agent/tests/test_template_v21.py TheToolKind builds an engine's bundle of each of two kinds on v21: B18 passes with the set and fails once a common skill is taken out.
